title: Kununu Company Search Scraper
description: Search Kununu company profiles with names, slugs, locations, industry IDs, ratings, review counts, and links. Batch keywords and page through employer matches.

queries.title: Company search queries
queries.description: Company names or keywords to search across public Kununu employer profiles.

query.title: Query
query.description: Company name or keyword used to search Kununu employer profiles.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of company matches requested for this search page.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Number of company matches to skip before returning the next page.

country_filter.title: Country filter
country_filter.description: One Kununu country code used to filter search matches. The code is sent as one countries[] value.

industry.description: Numeric Kununu industry identifier used to narrow a company search.
